label: Dust Creek
summary: A frontier town on the edge of the desert, two days from the railroad, where silver was found last spring.

world.setting: Dust Creek, a frontier town on the edge of the desert, two days from the railroad
world.description: One saloon, two churches, a bank robbed twice this year, and a sheriff who is new, unwanted and very good with a rifle. Silver was found in the hills last spring, and everyone wants a piece.
rules: Grounded: no magic, but legends grow fast
Guns are deadly, and gunfights are rare, quick and final
Reputation is everything; people remember what you did

narration.tone: Dusty and laconic, with a dry wit
